requiredSequence: verify exact baseline bytes and modes
apply only the named type-correct mutation in the runtime executor's isolated source
pass native and Svelte positive compilation
run the named behavioral test and require its intended assertion failure

controls.name: optimistic-check-display
controls.test: pending removal stays checked, then a failed removal stays checked with its failure
controls.intendedFailure: The pending row must remain aria-checked=true before the actual remove answer.

controls.name: uncontained-Escape
controls.mutation: Remove stopPropagation from the panel keydown listener and from onEscapeKeydown. Keep preventDefault and the same typed close request.
controls.test: Escape is contained and requests closure without turning a model answer into closure
controls.intendedFailure: The outer keydown listener receives Escape.

controls.name: duplicate-activation
controls.mutation: Remove the event.repeat early return for Space and Enter, keeping the same function signature and actual model.
controls.test: ArrowDown, Home, End, arrows, Space and Enter activate only their intended row
controls.intendedFailure: A repeated Enter after the first confirmed many-mode choice issues an unwanted untick.

controls.name: ignored-creation-refusal
controls.mutation: Return null for a refused create outcome and include answer.kind === 'refused' in the condition that collapses the creation form.
controls.test: creation followed by a refused selection keeps the refusal visible and does not close the picker
controls.intendedFailure: The actual refusal and the inline form disappear.

controls.name: shared-closed-model
controls.mutation: Move the existing PickerModel import into a module script. Add a module-level PickerModel | null cache and a typed factory taking ConstructorParameters<typeof PickerModel>[0]. Return cache ??= new PickerModel(options), and replace only the instance's new PickerModel call with that factory. This remains type-correct but shares one model across containers and opens.
tests: chooser is controlled, shows the supplied title, and uses independent models for independent opens
two chooser containers release and mutate only their own model
controls.intendedFailure: A closed first model is reused or a second container sends its choice through the first source.
